how: We read the website of every Los Angeles wedding florist listed on Lazo (441 listings, 301 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: same-day delivery shops, a tea room, a botanica, a flower market and retail florists whose wedding work is a side menu. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: Do you design on site with installation and teardown, or deliver arrangements? Ask what the venue charges for either.
What is coming out of the Los Angeles Flower Market in my month, and what has to be shipped in?
How do the flowers hold up in Santa Ana winds and heat? Ask what they would use for an outdoor fall wedding.

picks.name: The Flower Lab
picks.blurb: The Flower Lab designs refined, romantic florals for weddings and events across Los Angeles, with flowers treated as storytellers rather than decor. Its founder left a career in logistics to design weddings and says the aim is a personalized, luxury experience for each couple.

picks.name: Eveni Floral Design
picks.blurb: Zoey was raised in Taiwan, studied floral design in the UK and built Eveni Floral Design in Southern California around color, texture and movement. Garden-inspired florals for weddings, elopements and events, with a signature of softly vibrant color combinations.

picks.name: Ivory Florist weddings & Events
picks.blurb: Sepideh Mianaby founded Ivory Floral Events and began her floral career in 2007 after training with internationally known floral artists. The Santa Monica studio offers luxury wedding floral design plus full wedding and event planning for private and corporate clients across California.

picks.name: Floral Passion Events
picks.blurb: Floral Passion Events is a Los Angeles floral design and event decor studio built for large-scale work: flower walls, custom installations, floral letters and logos as well as weddings. It works with fresh flowers, premium faux florals and custom-built elements across LA, Orange County and Ventura County.

picks.name: Flowermaid
picks.blurb: Flowermaid is a boutique Los Angeles floral design studio doing weddings and events as well as everyday orders. The process starts by listening to the inspiration behind your ideas and working through lots of pictures so everyone is on the same page before the design is built.

picks.name: Unique Floral Designs
picks.blurb: Unique Floral Designs in Simi Valley has created custom florals for weddings, corporate and special events for over 20 years. Heather Wismann and Laurie Comeaux lead the design team, and the site lists features in Style Me Pretty, People and California Wedding Day.

picks.name: Oldvine Florals
picks.blurb: Itika Oldwine established Oldvine Florals in 2017 after working under Los Angeles floral designer Eric Buterbaugh. The woman-owned studio sits in downtown LA's Old Financial District, blocks from the Los Angeles Flower Market, and does bespoke wedding florals alongside corporate events.

picks.name: La Petite Gardenia
picks.blurb: La Petite Gardenia has made organically inspired floral compositions for over twenty years, from TV, editorial and museum work to weddings, in Los Angeles, New York and Europe. The studio also builds floral set pieces with some of Los Angeles' artisans for film sets and brand activations.

picks.name: Flowers By Laurel
picks.blurb: Lovorka opened Flowers by Laurel in 1993 after a path that ran through London, and her daughter Isabelle joined full time in 2019. A mother-daughter wedding and special-events florist serving South Bay and Los Angeles venues with fresh florals and timeless decor.

picks.name: Mitsuko Floral
picks.blurb: Mitsuko Floral is an experienced South Bay designer with three decades in floral work, creating bespoke designs for weddings and events out of Torrance. Romantic bouquets, centerpieces and floral installations, tailored by consultation.

picks.name: Rahely Flowers
picks.blurb: Rahely Flowers was founded in 2022 but says it is backed by over 20 years in the luxury wedding industry. The San Fernando studio does bespoke wedding and event florals and also runs flower deliveries and subscriptions across the Los Angeles area.

picks.name: Into-Blooms
picks.blurb: Bernadette started in flower shops part time, completed the Advanced Wedding Floral Design program at the Floral Design Institute and now treats each couple like family at Into-Blooms in Simi Valley. The site includes a frank page on sorting out a wedding flower budget, alongside its everyday delivery business.
